senses.gloss: €10U. (लाशयति-ते) To exercise or practise any art; cf. लस्.

I. 1, 4 P. (लषति-ते, लष्यति-ते, लषित) To wish, desire, long for, be eager for; रामाच्युतौ वो लषतो बुभुक्षितौ [[Bhāg. 10. 23. 7]]; (usually with the preposition अभि q. v.). --II. 10 U. (लाषयति-ते) = लश् q. v.

I. 1 P. (लसति, लसित) 
__1 To shine, glitter, flash; मुक्ताहारेण लसता हसतीव स्तनद्वयम् [[K. P. 10]]; करवाणि चरणद्वयं सरसलसदलक्तकरागम् [[Gīt. 10]]; [[Amaru. 19]]; बालेन नक्तंसमयेन मुक्तं रौप्यं लसड्डिम्बमिवेन्दुबिम्बम् [[N. 22. 53]] (v. l.). 
__2 To appear, arise, come to light. 
__3 To embrace. 
__4 To play, frolic about, skip about, dance. 
__4 To sound, resound. -Caus. (लासयति-ते) 
__1 To cause to shine, grace, adorn. 
__2 To cause to dance. 
__3 To exercise an art.

लशु(शू)नः -नम्
(अशेः उनन्, लशश्च [[Uṇ. 3. 55]]) Garlic; निखिलरसायनमहितो गन्धेनोग्रेण लशुन इव [[R. G.]] (= [[Bv. 1. 81]]); यशःसौरभ्यलशुनः [[Bv. 1. 93.]]
p. p. Wished, desired.
p. p. [लस्-क्त] Played, sported, appeared, manifested, skipping about &c.; see लस्.
[लष्-वन् [[Uṇ. 1. 142]]] An actor, a dancer.
= लासक q. v.
a. Having flashing rays (as the sun); मध्यमोपलनिभे लसदंशौ [[Ki. 9. 2.]]

[लसति लस्-अच्] 
__1 Saffron. 
__2 Turmeric.
Spittle, saliva.

__1 Saliva. 
__2 Pus, matter. 
__3 The juice of the sugar-cane. 
__4 Lymph. 
__5 A tendon, muscle.
a. Dancing; सविलासलासिकविलासिनीजनः [[Śi. 13. 66.]]

__1 A female dancer. 
__2 A harlot, wanton or unchaste woman. 
__3 A kind of dramatic performance.
a. [लस्-उषच् [[Uṇ. 4. 79]]] Shining.

a. 
__1 Embraced, clasped. 
__2 Skilful, skilled.

__1 Ā. (लज्जते, लज्जित) 1 To be ashamed, feel shame (oft. with instr. or inf.); स्रीजनं प्रहरन् कथं न लज्जसे [[Ratn. 2]]; [[Bk. 15. 33.]] 
__2 To blush. -Caus. (लज्जयति-ते) To put to shame; नर्तकीरभिनयातिलङ्घिनीः पार्श्वबर्तिषु गुरूष्वलज्जयत् [[R. 19. 14.]]
The middle of a bow, that part which is grasped.
m. A bow.

a. 
(-का or की f.) Covetous, greedy, avaricious; [[P. III. 2. 154.]]

[लस्-घञ्] 
__1 Jumping, sporting, skipping about, dancing; मदनजनितलासैः [[Ṛs. 6. 30.]] 
__2 Dalliance, wanton sport. 
__3 Dancing as practised by women. 
__4 Soup, broth.

a. 
(-सिका f.) [लस्-ण्वुल्] 
__1 Playing, frolicking, sporting. 
__2 Moving hither and thither. 
__3 Causing to dance; लासकः पादपानां … नभस्वान् [[Ṛs. 2. 26]] (the commentator Amarakīrti, however, says, “लासकः संसर्गवान्”). 
-कः 
__1 A dancer. 
__2 A peacock. 
__3 Embracing. 
__4 N. of Śiva. 
-कम् A room on the top of a building, turret.
A female dancer.
Moving hither and thither; तोमराङ्कुशलासनैः [[Mb. 7. 142. 45.]]

[लस्-ण्यत्] 
__1 Dancing; a dance; आस्ये धास्यति कस्य लास्यमधुना … वाचां विपाको मम [[Bv. 4. 42]]; [[R. 16. 14.]] 
__2 A dance accompanied with singing and instrumental music. 
__3 A dance in which the emotions of love [Page1365-2] are represented by means of various gesticulations and attitudes; अरुणाधरकिरणबालकिसलयलास्यहेतुभिः [[Dk. 2. 5.]] 
-स्यः A dancer, an actor. 
-स्या A dancing girl.
A gimlet.
